summary: Kilroy Realty, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase and other lenders, replacing its prior revolving credit facility. The new senior unsecured facility permits borrowings up to $1.25 billion, with a $100 million letter of credit sublimit and an accordion feature allowing up to an additional $450 million in commitments or term loans. The facility is for general corporate purposes and acquisitions. This filing pertains solely to a routine refinancing of existing credit lines, not a special situation transaction such as a merger, tender offer, or restructuring.
